about: suspicious seeds for the A-Identity NEAR real-data dataset: accounts publicly reported as scam, phishing, fake-airdrop, drainer or exploit accounts, each with the report's URL, date and an exact quote (whitespace and non-ASCII normalized), plus accounts tied to a reported fake-airdrop campaign by on-chain facts under the documented campaign rule (source_type onchain_campaign_link). Risk signals, not accusations. source_type says how strong the evidence is; see README for the rules.

accounts.notes: NEP-141 'rewards' token imitating LiNEAR, mass-airdropped, its name advertises a lookalike website. Created by burrowfinancedao.near. Fits the pattern NEAR Protocol warned about on 2022-10-09: unexpected airdropped tokens whose names carry links (see SOURCES.md).

evidence.quote: three NEP-141 tokens named after LiNEAR, Meta Pool and Burrow (`linear_protocol.near`, `metapools.near`, `burrowfinancedao.near`), each advertising a lookalike website in its token name
Its token name advertises a website (https://linearprotocol.net): the fake-airdrop pattern
